-- Phase 1: declarations and contracts for read_note.
-- Untrusted names are checked by safe_name before any file access.

-- True only for a plain file name: no path separators and not "." or "..".
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post not out or name.split("/").len() == 1
  post not out or name.split("\\").len() == 1
  post not out or (name != "." and name != "..")
  post not out or name.char_count() > 0
  ex safe_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  ex safe_name("a/b") == False
  name.char_count() > 0 and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Returns the text of `name` inside the `notes` directory.
-- A missing, unreadable, or unsafe name gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post safe_name(name) or out == ""
  if not safe_name(name)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(name) else ""
